title: The first city to require solar roofs
text: In March 2013, the Lancaster city council voted unanimously to require solar panels on new homes, making it the first city in the United States to do so. The rule took effect on January 1, 2014. Homes on lots of 7,000 square feet or more must have a solar system of 1.0 to 1.5 kilowatts.
